about.title: Democratizing access to financial <italic>data.</italic>
about.intro: BullMetrics is a fundamental data analysis platform designed for all types of investors.

problem.title: Our Goal
problem.text: To give the individual investor easy, structured, and transparent access to corporate financial statements. By automating the extraction of complex SEC reports, we free up your time for what really matters: value analysis.

organization.title: The Bullocracy
organization.text: BullMetrics is built by The Bullocracy, an organization of young students seeking to democratize access to knowledge about Politics, Economics, and Investments. To achieve this, they create content on social media, from YouTube to TikTok, fostering a space for our community to write articles and opinions to be published online, on the website thebullocracy.com, where they stimulate free debate and financial literacy.

team.title: The Team
team.description: The entire platform is designed by people who understand and want to learn more about the markets, ensuring our tools reflect the real needs of fundamental analysis.

members.name: Rodrigo Martins
members.bio: Economics student at the University of Minho. Responsible for marketing strategy, site indexing, SEO, analytics metrics, and overall platform performance optimization, as well as the integration of BullMetrics into Bullocracy's content.

members.name: Tiago Costa
members.bio: Economics student at the University of Minho. Responsible for the conceptualization of the platform's ecosystem and features, defining the direction of tools, and focusing on product usability.

members.name: Alexandre Machado
members.bio: [Insert course/university]. Responsible for the technical development of the platform, designing the interface, and building the backend and frontend structure with a focus on code and software architecture.

philosophy.title: Data Philosophy
philosophy.text: Our analysis is based on mathematics and official reports extracted directly from the SEC. BullMetrics focuses on the solidity of numbers. We believe that financial decisions require clean data, technical precision, and transparency, characteristics we value deeply at BullMetrics.

contact.title: Official Contacts
contact.text: Do you have questions, partnership proposals, or want to know more about the entire platform? The Bullocracy team is at your disposal.
